sources.source_name: TomTom Traffic Index - Riyadh city page (tomtom.com/traffic-index/city/riyadh)

historical_depth.detail: City page carries full-year 2025 metrics with an explicit year-over-year comparison to 2024 ('66 hours ... 5 hours 6 minutes less than in 2024'), so at least 2024 and 2025 full-year values are inside the July 2021 - July 2026 window. Pre-2024 values are NOT shown on the current page (older editions rotate off each January); 2021-2023 must come from archived report PDFs or news republishers.

has_speed_or_congestion_fields.detail: Index publishes congestion level (%), average travel time per 10 km, average speed (km/h), and rush-hour time lost per year. Congestion level defined in results as comparing 'ideal freeflow travel times with real-world average travel times, expressed as a percentage'. CAUTION: one search pass reported Riyadh's average speed / distance-driven-in-15-min fields as 'N/A (not available)' on the current page, while another pass returned specific values - see notes.

keyless_access.detail: Public web page, no login/API key/payment; values surface directly in search snippets. A downloadable report also exists at https://www.tomtom.com/downloads/traffic-index-report/ (access conditions not visible in search output).

sources.source_name: INRIX Global Traffic Scorecard

historical_depth.detail: Annual scorecard editions exist for every year in the July 2021 - July 2026 window: 2021 PDF (smarttransportpub.blob.core.windows.net), 2022 edition (inrix.com/scorecard-2022/ and citygo-project.eu PDF), 2023 city pages (inrix.com/scorecard-city-2023/), 2024 PDF (ftnnews.com mirror) and 2025 PDF (sipotra.it mirror, published Dec 2025). The Riyadh city page is titled 'scorecard-city-2024', confirming Riyadh in the 2024 edition. Riyadh's per-year numeric rows for 2021-2023 and 2025 were NOT visible in any snippet and remain unverified.

has_speed_or_congestion_fields.detail: Scorecard's headline metric is annual 'hours lost' to congestion (e.g., 'Istanbul topping the global list with 118 hours lost' in the 2025 edition; 'Istanbul's 105 hours lost' in 2024). Search-result text for inrix.com also states city scorecards include 'last mile speeds into downtown during the morning commute', so a speed field exists. Riyadh's own speed/hours values were not visible in snippets.

keyless_access.detail: Full annual scorecard PDFs are downloadable with no key/login from third-party mirrors surfaced in search: 2021 (https://smarttransportpub.blob.core.windows.net/web/1/root/inrix-2021-global-traffic-scorecard-updated46.pdf), 2022 (https://citygo-project.eu/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/2022_INRIX_Traffic_Scorecard_Report.pdf), 2024 (https://ftnnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/INRIX_2024_Global_Traffic_Scorecard.pdf), 2025 (https://www.sipotra.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/2025-INRIX-Global-Traffic-Scorecard.pdf). The interactive Riyadh city page (inrix.com/scorecard-city/?city=Riyadh&index=31) is a public web page. Underlying INRIX raw data/APIs, by contrast, require a commercial license or developer trial account.

pricing.summary: Scorecard reports and city pages are free. Underlying data/API licensing is not publicly priced (contact sales); search results state 'INRIX offers a free trial to get access to traffic, analytics, and parking related insights with their APIs' and a third-party estimate that 'INRIX Parking pricing generally falls between $3,000 and $15,000/year for base data access or analytics subscriptions' (general budgeting estimate, not official).
pricing.free_tier: Free: annual Scorecard PDFs and per-city scorecard pages; free developer API trial. No published self-serve pricing for full data licensing.

sources.source_name: Numbeo Traffic Index (Riyadh)

historical_depth.detail: Numbeo publishes annual and mid-year Traffic Index snapshot rankings covering the whole 2021-2026 window; distinct pages surfaced in search for 2021 (rankings.jsp?title=2021, rankings_by_country.jsp?title=2021 and title=2021-mid), 2022 (rankings_by_country.jsp?title=2022), 2023 (title=2023, title=2023-mid), 2024 (title=2024), and 2026 / 2026 Mid-Year (rankings.jsp?title=2026, rankings.jsp current page titled 'Traffic Index by City 2026 Mid-Year'). Riyadh's specific value in each year's table was NOT visible in snippets (only 2021 Asia leaders were quoted: Colombo 307.66, Delhi 285.09, Sharjah 283.43), so per-year Riyadh values remain unverified until the pages are fetched.

has_speed_or_congestion_fields.detail: Publishes a composite congestion-style Traffic Index ('considers factors such as commute time, dissatisfaction with time spent in traffic, CO2 emissions, and overall traffic system inefficiencies'), a Time Index (average one-way commute minutes), an Inefficiency Index, and CO2 emissions per passenger. keyless_access.detail: All surfaced pages (city page /traffic/in/Riyadh, yearly rankings pages, country pages, city-vs-city comparison pages, indices_explained.jsp) are public web pages requiring no API key, login, or payment to view. pricing.summary: Web pages with current and by-year snapshot Traffic Index values are free to view. Commercial API/data licensing exists but no pricing appeared in search results (UNVERIFIED).

sources.source_name: TomTom Move / Traffic Stats (incl. free TomTom Traffic Index city page for Riyadh)

historical_depth.detail: Search result text: 'Data is available back to 2008 and can be defined by any date range' and 'Traffic Stats provides access to 10+ year historical traffic archive available in more than 70 countries.' This fully spans the July 2021 - July 2026 window. Result URLs backing this: https://trafficstats.tomtom.com/static/html/help/HistoricalTraffic.html (page titled 'About historical traffic data') and https://www.tomtom.com/products/traffic-stats/. Note: quotes surfaced in WebSearch summary of these results, not from a direct page fetch.

has_speed_or_congestion_fields.detail: Search result text: Traffic Stats provides 'average and median speeds, speed limits, road types, travel times and sample sizes across entire road networks in over 70 countries' (result set including https://www.tomtom.com/products/traffic-stats/). The free Traffic Index Riyadh page shows average speed, congestion level, and travel time per 10 km.

keyless_access.detail: Traffic Stats raw/custom reports require MOVE portal registration (30-day free trial, then Move Credits one-off purchases or annual Enterprise subscription per ResearchGate discussion) or an API key. EXCEPTION: the annual TomTom Traffic Index city page for Riyadh (tomtom.com/traffic-index/city/riyadh) is public, keyless, and its headline values appear directly in search snippets.

pricing.summary: Quote-only for the core product. Cost model per ResearchGate thread (https://www.researchgate.net/post/Cost_of_TomTom_Move_Traffic_Stats_for_academic_research): 'one-off purchases of Move Credits for a specific time and location, or an annual Enterprise subscription'. Per ADCi reseller result set (https://www.adci.com/tomtom-traffic-analytics): 'Licensing for TomTom Traffic Stats is based on the cost per directional mile.' No numeric prices appeared in any search result.
pricing.free_tier: 30-day free trial of the MOVE Portal ('sign up for a 30-day free trial on the MOVE Portal... you'll receive an API key'). Free annual Traffic Index city reports (no key).

Annual Traffic Index values are yearly aggregates only (2024, 2025 editions visible), not raw time series; raw history needs paid Traffic Stats. Free trial (30 days) could yield a genuine Riyadh historical report at zero cost.

sources.source_name: Google Maps Distance Matrix API (legacy) / Routes API

historical_depth.detail: Retrospective queries are impossible: result text for the legacy Distance Matrix docs states 'The departure_time must be set to the current time or some time in the future and cannot be in the past.' Historical data is used only internally for predictions ('duration_in_traffic... the predicted time in traffic based on historical averages', trafficModel=best_guess). The Routes API 'allows you to specify whether live or historical traffic should be taken into account in route calculations' - i.e., predictive blending, not a queryable July 2021-2026 archive. A Google Maps Community thread ('Selecting departure time to pre-COVID-19 date is not using true/accurate historical data?', support.google.com/maps/thread/50594492) corroborates no true historical retrieval.

has_speed_or_congestion_fields.detail: Returns duration_in_traffic (predicted travel time per O-D element) - field name visible in results (e.g. GitHub issue 'Distance Matrix duration_in_traffic value is not accurate using the best_guess traffic model'). No congestion-level or road-segment speed fields; travel time only.

keyless_access.detail: API key + billing account required; pay-as-you-go per element.

pricing.summary: Per search result text: 'The Compute Route Matrix endpoint has three pricing tiers based on the cost per element - Basic ($5), Advanced ($10 CPM) and Preferred ($15 CPM)' where CPM = per 1,000 billable elements; 'The Basic tier has no real time traffic, while the Advanced tier is enabled when you use TRAFFIC_AWARE or TRAFFIC_AWARE_OPTIMAL' (result set incl. blog.afi.io and woosmap.com guides). Legacy Distance Matrix: two SKUs, basic and Advanced (traffic-aware), billed per element (origins x destinations); departure_time+driving capped at 100 elements/request. A third-party guide also references '$200 credits' (nicolalazzari.ai result title).
pricing.free_tier: $200-credit model referenced in third-party result title (nicolalazzari.ai, 'Google Maps APIs: $/SKU breakdown + $200 credits (2026)'); exact current free-call allowance not visible in snippets.

sources.notes: Disqualified for the historical requirement: cannot query any past date, so July 2021 - mid-2026 retrospective Riyadh data is unobtainable regardless of budget. Only usable going forward (schedule traffic-aware matrix calls from now on) or for typical-week predictive profiles at ~$10 per 1,000 traffic-aware elements.

sources.source_name: xmap.ai - Saudi Arabia Road Traffic Data catalog

historical_depth.detail: Result text: data covers 'traffic densities, average speeds, and congestion during peak hours, both in real-time and historically' and 'real-time and historical data on traffic density, accidents, road conditions, and congestion trends' - historical existence confirmed, but NO date range or archive depth appeared in any snippet, so July 2021 - July 2026 coverage is unconfirmed.

has_speed_or_congestion_fields.detail: Result text names fields: 'the arithmetic mean of speed data', 'the middle value of speed measurements' (median speed), 'the maximum legally permitted speed on a road segment' (speed limit), road name, plus 'segment-level traffic counts, speeds, and congestion scores' (xmap.ai catalog result set).

keyless_access.detail: Result text: options are to 'download samples and contact sales' - full datasets are sales-gated; whether sample downloads need signup was not visible in snippets.

pricing.summary: Quote-only. No prices appeared in any search result; catalog pages direct to sales.
pricing.free_tier: Sample downloads offered on catalog pages (gating unknown).

sources.notes: Riyadh explicitly covered: blog result text says their analysis 'is based on the median speeds across various streets of Riyadh' and 'explores the relationship between points of interest (POIs) and traffic flow in Riyadh', but no numeric Riyadh speed/congestion values surfaced in snippets. Historical depth and data provenance (likely resold from a larger probe-data provider) are the two open questions for a sales call. Smallest/most opaque vendor in this family.

sources.source_name: Otonomo / Wejo (connected-vehicle data brokers)

historical_depth.detail: Both companies exited the market in 2023, before most of the needed window could be serviced today. Result text (S&P Global): 'In February, Otonomo was acquired by Urgent.ly for just $270 million. In May, Wejo declared bankruptcy.' and 'Otonomo and Wejo, two of the largest players in the connected vehicle space, have exited the market.' No purchasable July 2021 - July 2026 archive exists from either.

has_speed_or_congestion_fields.detail: Not applicable - no live product. Historically CV movement data, but no field-level evidence in snippets.

keyless_access.detail: Not applicable - defunct. Nothing downloadable.

pricing.summary: Not purchasable. Context from result text: 'In 2022, both companies combined produced revenue of just $15 million, against operating expenses of more than $250 million.' Note the '$270 million' Otonomo acquisition figure is quoted verbatim from the S&P/search result text and looks inconsistent with contemporaneous reporting of a much smaller deal - treat as snippet-level only.

sources.notes: Saudi Arabia coverage was never confirmed in any snippet even historically.
